Antwerp's rough trade is hearing a new word from De Beers: stabilizing.

CEO Al Cook, in Beijing for the Natural Diamond Declaration signing, says rough prices are turning after two years of declines, as supply falls more than 10% and mines close.

Antwerpen: De Beers-topman Al Cook zegt dat ruwe-diamantprijzen stabiliseren nu het aanbod meer dan 10% terugvalt.
